text: Community-centered and regional trends in survey responses are being analyzed using statistical software, to identify patterns in food preferences of different ages, grades, genders, and communities.

Working collaboratively with community research coordinators in Paulatuk and Tuktoyaktuk, we developed an image-based survey and received input from both school administrators and the regional Beaufort Delta Divisional Education Council.
